subtitle: An absorber integration, not a brake
description: A replaceable purchased energy absorber, bumper face and bolted mounting plate for a later crane end-stop programme. Absorber internals and force-stroke characteristics are not designed.
targets: E / s only; peak force unknown
Impact mass, speed and duty required
decisions: Partner with an absorber specialist rather than infer impact qualification from brake work.
Use a replaceable mounting interface and visible stroke envelope.
Size the machine attachment for verified peak force, not E/s average.
materials: Absorber and bumper face: supplier-controlled hydraulic/elastomer components.
risks: No metering geometry, damping curve or peak force established.
Travel envelope does not demonstrate energy absorption.
steps: Collect impact mass, speed, available stroke and recovery interval.
Select rated absorber and replace CAD envelope with supplier model.
Approve foundation fasteners and collision clearance.
validation: Supplier force-stroke curve and machine structure analysis.
Instrumented impact, temperature and repeated-impact tests.
hypotheses: Compare removable cartridge service with the customer baseline.
No performance multiple assigned before impact testing.
sensors: Stroke/end-position and impact-event recording only; define survival environment and cable protection.
